purpose: Provide evidence-backed human-review signals for whether the GHOST Energy x A&W Root Beer thesis is being realized, weakening, or becoming widely known. The monitor does not make or execute a trade decision.
exact_implication: GHOST x A&W Root Beer is producing sustained incremental demand, distribution, replenishment or repeat purchase that is economically relevant to GHOST and changes expectations for KDP.

decision_authority.rule: Every triggered state requests review. No state means buy, hold, sell, close, roll or resize automatically.

search_attention.comparison: For each identity-preserving query, compare the latest seven complete days with the prior seven complete days inside the same source request. Never compare raw levels across independently normalized requests or geographies.

states.SEARCH_BUILDING_BASELINE: History is missing, sparse, failed or not yet repeated enough for a decline conclusion.
states.SEARCH_SOFTENING: One identity-preserving query is at or below 75% of its prior-seven-day mean for two consecutive successful runs while the other query is not increasing.
states.SEARCH_COOLING_REVIEW: Both identity-preserving queries are at or below 75% of their prior-seven-day means for two consecutive successful runs.

review_policy.SEARCH_SOFTENING: Emit a human review signal and retain the next comparable check; this is not an exit instruction.
review_policy.SEARCH_COOLING_REVIEW: Set HUMAN_EXIT_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Vincent decides what to do.

conversation_volume.headline_measurement: Count every deduplicated exact original post successfully observed, separately by platform and across positive, negative, neutral, mixed and unclassified sentiment. Promotional or commercially unresolved exact posts remain in this observed-buzz total but not in the independent investing-quality subset.
conversation_volume.investing_quality_measurement: Separately count newly published, deduplicated, exact, independently qualifying original posts in fixed recent and prior seven-day windows by platform.
conversation_volume.qualifying_record: An exact original post with a publication timestamp, author or explicit missing-author state, URL and explicit reviewed commercial origin that is allowed to count as independent behavior.
conversation_volume.comparability: A run is comparable only when all five production-shaped canaries are healthy, all five candidate queries are terminal, fixed windows and query identity match, and every platform used for a decline calculation is uncapped and untruncated. Missing or failed coverage is indeterminate, never zero conversation.

states.CONVERSATION_BUILDING_BASELINE: Fewer than two comparable scheduled runs or an open source, timestamp, origin, cap or truncation gap prevents a direction call.
states.CONVERSATION_SOFTENING: At least two healthy uncapped platforms are at or below 75% of their prior-seven-day qualifying exact independent-original-post counts for two consecutive comparable runs.
states.CONVERSATION_COOLING_REVIEW: At least two healthy uncapped platforms are at or below 50% of their prior-seven-day qualifying exact independent-original-post counts for two consecutive comparable runs.

review_policy.CONVERSATION_SOFTENING: Emit a human review signal and retain the next comparable check; this is not an exit instruction.
review_policy.CONVERSATION_COOLING_REVIEW: Set HUMAN_EXIT_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Vincent decides what to do.

sentiment_context.rule: Positive and negative reactions both contribute to attention and trial context. Sentiment direction never cancels conversation volume, suppresses disliked evidence, or independently triggers a trade or exit review.
sentiment_context.minimum_display: Show the sample denominator, platform and thread coverage, collection window, caps or truncation, and unclassified count. If comparable sentiment history was not collected, say so.

human_review_triggers: Availability fades after the first allocation.
The product remains a short-lived LTO.
Review enthusiasm fails to become repeat purchase.
Heavy discounting or scarcity explains the signal.
A&W mainly cannibalizes other GHOST SKUs.
KDP energy momentum decelerates against tougher comparisons.
A&W remains too small to change GHOST or KDP expectations even in an aggressive case.
thesis_strength.review_policy: A verified invalidation condition sets THESIS_INVALIDATION_REVIEW. Unresolved or source-failed checks remain unresolved and cannot be treated as verified weakness.

news_and_management_coverage.paywalled_research_rule: Paywalled or private research is outside the public monitor and must remain not_observable_not_checked, never silently counted as checked or absent.
news_and_management_coverage.qualifying_coverage: Independent business or financial coverage that addresses the exact A&W-to-GHOST/KDP economic implication. Generic launch, product review, affiliate, retailer, copied or syndicated release coverage does not qualify.

states.NICHE_ONLY: Zero qualifying independent business or financial outlets and no explicit KDP management attribution.
states.EARLY_BUSINESS_COVERAGE: One or two qualifying independent business or financial outlets in the latest 14 calendar days and no explicit KDP management attribution.
states.EXTENSIVE_COVERAGE_REVIEW: At least three qualifying independent business or financial outlets in the latest 14 calendar days, or explicit KDP management attribution of A&W to sales, volume, distribution, share, margin, guidance or earnings.
states.SOURCE_FAILURE: A required official, filing, transcript or public-search route failed. This is operational missingness, not market silence.

review_policy.EARLY_BUSINESS_COVERAGE: Emit a human information-parity review signal because coverage is broadening, but do not label it extensive or issue an automatic exit instruction.
review_policy.EXTENSIVE_COVERAGE_REVIEW: Set INFORMATION_PARITY_REVIEW. Vincent decides what to do.

news_and_management_coverage.evidence_display: Show every qualifying outlet link and every management passage with source and timestamp, not only a count.

dashboard_contract.first_screen: Lead with successfully observed retailer, search and total exact-conversation results and how they changed. Show sentiment and independent-investing-quality counts as context. State any human review signal without allowing operational source failures to replace the surviving observed result.
dashboard_contract.sensor_freshness: Show an independent timestamp, operational state, latest attempt and last complete comparable reading for search, conversation, sentiment, thesis checks and news or management coverage.
dashboard_contract.charts: Retail charts use only verified complete daily samples. Search charts show a daily rolling seven-day percentage change calculated within one successful identity-preserving request. Leave failed or missing observations as gaps and never bridge non-comparable dates.
dashboard_contract.last_verified_rule: A fully failed refresh stays behind audit while the last successful observation remains visible under its original timestamp. Never relabel the earlier observation as the failed date.
dashboard_contract.audit: Source failures and sanitized attempt status stay inside a closed audit detail unless no usable result survives. Page load and refresh read persisted artifacts only and make zero upstream source calls.
dashboard_contract.evidence_links: Every displayed original-post and comment/reply count must reconcile to complete clickable persisted evidence by platform or show a mismatch. Displayed sentiment must have record-level linked classifications; an aggregate without that lineage stays audit-only.

runtime_acceptance: One durable tested runner under scripts/ creates a unique immutable run directory and separate latest pointers.
The runner uses shared source connectors and receipts rather than dated tmp collectors or hardcoded final states.
Conversation collection persists publication timestamp, author, exact URL, origin, cap, truncation and source health for every original post.
Sentiment is derived only from cited collected text and remains secondary context.
News and management classification is data-driven and tests NICHE_ONLY, EARLY_BUSINESS_COVERAGE, EXTENSIVE_COVERAGE_REVIEW and SOURCE_FAILURE paths.
Thesis checks can transition from unresolved to supporting, contradicting or source failure from persisted evidence; verified contradiction requests human review.
The authenticated dashboard renders the monitoring and private decision layers without placing position values in public static assets.
Focused and full tests plus desktop 1440px and mobile 390px QA pass before deployment.
